sent_bad: Congress addressed these with the Banking Act of 1933 (doc.txt).

**Not a cause of the 2008 crisis:** those who believe its absence did not cause the crisis "highlight that offering mortgages has always been a core business for commercial banks," and "Glass-Steagall was never intended to address or regulate loan qualification standards." (doc.txt)

**Worsened underwriting standards:** after the repeal, "it is feasible that universal banks aimed to establish an initial market share in the securities market by lowering underwriting standards," and "universal banks might also self-deal and favor their own interests over those of their customers.
